title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 86
description: Ten questions on Psalms 86: a poor and needy servant calls on the Lord, who is good, ready to forgive and slow to anger.

questions.text: Why does the psalmist ask Yahweh to hear and answer him in verse 1?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says: "Hear, Yahweh, and answer me, for I am poor and needy."

answers.text: Because he is poor and needy
Because he has kept the law

questions.text: How often does the psalmist call to the Lord, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says: "Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long."

questions.text: Verse 5 says the Lord is good and ready to do what?
questions.explanation: Verse 5 says: "For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive."

questions.text: Among whom is there no one like the Lord, according to verse 8?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says: "There is no one like you among the gods, Lord."

questions.text: What will all the nations God has made come and do?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says all nations you have made will come and worship before you and glorify your name.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask God to make his heart in verse 11?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says: "Make my heart undivided to fear your name."

questions.text: From where has God delivered the psalmist's soul?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says: "You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol."

answers.text: From the hand of the king

questions.text: Who has risen up against the psalmist in verse 14?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says the proud have risen up against him, and a company of violent men have sought after his soul.

answers.text: The proud, and a company of violent men

questions.text: Verse 15 calls the Lord merciful, gracious and slow to what?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says the Lord is a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger.

questions.text: What does the psalmist ask God to show him in the last verse?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says: "Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed."
